Yemenis Flee South Amidst Ongoing Houthi Attacks

Yemenis are fleeing their homes in the south of the country due to ongoing attacks by Houthi forces. The displacement highlights the continuing conflict and its impact on civilians. The situation underscores the persistent security challenges in the region.
